input.text: Saved my preset and everything synced across devices instantly. Magical.
Replacement part came in three days. Installation guide was sparse but enough.
Documentation is current. Examples could be more varied.
Movie was incoherent. The good actors were wasted on a bad script.
Park was open. Restrooms were clean. The playground was crowded.
Earbuds pair quickly to one device. Switching between two is fiddly.
Sleep tracking finally gave me data I trust. Cross-checked with my watch.
The light in the bathroom was warm. The shower pressure was uneven.
Restaurant was busy but seats turned over quickly enough.
Their tutorial videos are all from 2019 and reference removed features. Useless onboarding.
Driver took the long way and the meter ran 40% over a normal fare.
Two flight delays, lost bag, and the agent at the desk shrugged. Awful trip.
Color was approximately what the website showed. Fit was close to the size chart.
Air filtering on this purifier dropped my allergy meds usage in half.
Two-factor felt friction-free for once. The app is solid.
The app's notifications cannot be turned off. It pings me at 2am about news.
Software does what we hired it to do. Could be 30% faster.
Driver was on time. Car was clean. Quiet ride.
Walking distance to the metro. Three flights of stairs in the building.
Driver refused to use the trunk for my luggage. Trip felt unsafe.
My grandmother could use this app unaided. That's the highest praise I have.
Headphones leak so much sound my coworkers could follow my podcast.
Battery dies in three hours. Cannot use it for a single workday.
Refrigerator's freezer compartment cannot hold zero. Ice cream is always soft.
Tea was hot, the pastry was day-of. Service was attentive but slow.
Listing said quiet street. Construction starts under the bedroom window at 6am.
My six-year-old reads this book to herself now. Couldn't be happier.
Their CLI is a joy. Tab completion is comprehensive and the docs are excellent.
Loved every chapter. The pacing kept me up past midnight twice.
Even after a year of daily wear, no scratches and no battery drift.
Best headphones I've ever owned. The noise cancellation is unreal.
Conference WiFi held up for chat and slides. Video calls were rough.
Customer success rep proactively flagged we'd be hitting our plan limit. Nice touch.
Vacuum suction is so weak it can't pick up loose hair off carpet.
Class size was advertised as small. There were twelve of us.
Driver took the route the app suggested. Cabin was a little warm.
Their bug-fix turnaround is the best I've seen from any vendor.
My order arrived complete and on time. Box was a little scuffed.
Sweater pilled badly after a single wash on the gentle cycle. Disappointing fiber quality.
Pizza was edible. The crust was a little dry. The toppings were the right amount.
Shipping was a day early and the box was well-protected. Perfect transaction.
Restaurant accommodated a dietary restriction without fuss. Portion was on the small side.
Power bank charges as advertised. Cable was not included.
Setup took the documented time. No surprises either way.
It does the one thing it advertises. I expected slightly more for the price.
Toy paint chipped within a day. Choking hazard for the recipient's age range.
Bookstore had a small selection of what I was looking for. Staff were polite.
Coffee tasted burnt. Pastry was day-old at best. Will not return.
Doors don't lock reliably. Had to wedge a chair behind one overnight.
Cargo space swallowed everything we packed for two weeks abroad.
Dishwasher cleans dishes. It's loud during the dry cycle.
Driver smelled strongly of smoke. Made the 40-minute ride miserable.
Soup came cold. Server was unbothered when we mentioned it. Won't return.
Two-day shipping arrived on day two. Box was reused. Item was new.
Cabin smelled like wet dog from the first minute. Driver had no air freshener.
Sushi was clearly cut fresh and the rice was perfect. Going back next week.
The wifi works. Speeds are fine for browsing, slow for downloads.
Massage was the standard 50 minutes. Pressure was as requested.
Bag fits the laptop. Strap is okay. Color is darker in person.
Hotel had loud construction starting at 7am every day. They knew and didn't warn us.
Tour was on schedule. Guide read from notes most of the time.
App syncs across devices, mostly. Once a week I have to log out and back in.
Phone has a green tint visible against any white background. Replacement also had it.
Sound quality at concert volume with zero distortion. Highly recommend.
Bakery's sourdough has the kind of crust I haven't had since I was in Lyon.
Battery life exceeded the advertised hours. Easily a full day of heavy use.
Hummus was creamy, garlic just right, and the warm pita kept coming. Excellent.
Their integrations Just Work™. We had data flowing in twenty minutes.
Hiking boots felt broken in by the third mile. No blisters at all.
Pancakes were fine. Syrup was the generic kind. Coffee was acceptable.
Bike fit was meticulous and my back hasn't ached on rides since.
Tracks calories effortlessly and the streak feature actually motivates me.
Their CSV import handled my messy file without complaining once.
Pricing tier covered our needs for now. We will reassess next quarter.
Update broke the only feature I used the software for. No rollback path.
Restored my full workflow after a hard reset in under two minutes. Lifesaver.
The keyboard started double-typing within a month. Repair quote was half the device price.
Carpet had stains that pre-existed our stay. Manager refused to move us.
Insurance claim took six months and required a lawyer to move it along.
Newsletter shows up in my inbox each week. About half the articles are relevant to me.
Dryer beeps loudly when done. Drying time matches the dial.
Phone case adds protection. Adds noticeable bulk too.
Vacation rental host left a welcome basket and clear instructions for everything.
Tasting menu paced perfectly, sommelier nailed every pairing.
Subscription page hides cancellation behind three confirmation modals.
Eco-mode actually halved our electricity bill. Numbers don't lie.
Couch fit through the door with two inches to spare. Cushions are firm.
Crisp screen, snappy keyboard, and the trackpad finally rivals the competition.
Game crashes to desktop every 30 minutes. Patch notes don't mention it.
Plumber came when scheduled. Job took roughly what was quoted.
Repair shop got it done same day for less than the quote. Honest folks.
Headset is comfortable for an hour. After two, my ears start to hurt.
Charger stopped working after two weeks. Warranty process took six emails to start.
Their bookkeeping flow finally made tax season painless this year.
Worked perfectly out of the box, no fiddling required. Beautifully done.
Their cancellation flow was respectful and quick. Refunded the same day.
Returns were processed in the advertised window. Refund showed up day eight.
Hotel was a short walk to dinner spots. The building was on the older side.
Refurb arrived looking new. Battery health 97%. Couldn't ask for more.
Their data export is a 300MB XML file. No CSV, no JSON, no API.
Steakhouse with seafood ambitions — got both wrong. Disappointing all around.
Editor handles 500MB files without breaking a sweat. Tooling I'd actually pay for.
Hostel had bedbug bites on three of four nights. Got a partial refund only after escalating.
Picked this up on a whim and now I use it daily. Absolute steal.
This recipe finally taught me how to actually make decent risotto at home.
Adequate for the price. I'd buy again if mine broke.
Trainer spent more time on his phone than with the group. Refund request denied.
Class was structured around standard exercises. Instructor was competent.
Drone hovered rock-steady in 30 km/h winds. Genuinely impressive flight controller.
The restaurant takes reservations. Tables are close together. Volume gets loud after 8pm.
The book is mostly padding. The two good chapters are buried in 300 forgettable ones.
The food was fine. Service was fine. We will probably try somewhere else next time.
Trainer was knowledgeable, patient, and made even the hardest sets feel doable.
The hotel charged me three times for the same incidental. Took four calls to reverse.
Restaurant said our reservation was unconfirmed despite the email proving otherwise.
Crystal clear video on a slow hotel connection. No idea how they pulled it off.
Knife dulled within a week of light use. The 'lifetime' warranty is unrechable.
Coffee was hot. Not great, not bad. Filled the cup.
Massage worked out every knot I came in with. Booked again on the way out.
Restaurant ran out of half the menu by 7pm on a Saturday. Why open?
Camera in low light is genuinely shocking — phones don't usually do this well.
After a year, this jacket still looks new even after weekly use.
Tour guide knew every detail and adjusted the pace to the group. Stellar.
The lemon tart was the highlight — light, citrusy, and not too sweet.
Hotel staff went out of their way to make us feel welcome. Will book again next year.
Hotel check-in took about 20 minutes due to a queue. Once at the desk it was quick.
Completely defective. Won't even turn on. Returning today.
Their dev support engineer found my issue faster than I could explain it.
Coffee notes were exactly as described — caramel and stone fruit, very clean cup.
Software updates come on time. Some adds features I don't use.
Works as advertised. Nothing extraordinary, nothing broken.
Returns require paying shipping AND a 15% restocking fee. Buried in the FAQ.
Two refund requests sent. Both ignored. Filed a chargeback this morning.
The new dashboard is intuitive and saved me hours of monthly reporting.
The room had a window. View was a parking lot. Bed was comfortable.
Lecture was unprepared. Slides were last year's with the date Sharpied over.
Helmet arrived with cracked padding inside. Definitely not safe.
Lobster roll lived up to every Yelp review I had read on the way there.
Reliable, fast, and gorgeous to look at. No regrets at all.
Customer support resolved my issue in under five minutes. Genuinely impressed.
Hair color came out two shades darker than what we agreed. Stylist blamed my hair.
Tickets were easy to purchase online. The venue line moved at a normal pace.
Air conditioning brought the room down to 23C. It took about 20 minutes.
Movie theater seats reclined. The audio was a touch quiet.
Wireless connection holds steady but speeds vary throughout the day.
Pasta was hand-rolled, sauce was a revelation, and the wine pairing was spot on.
Bike-share rebalances often enough that I always find one nearby.
Course materials were five years out of date. Examples reference deprecated APIs.
Streaming buffered every 10 minutes on a fiber connection. Their CDN is broken.
Three months in and the keyboard still feels brand new. Worth every penny.
Audiobook narrator brought every character to life. Couldn't stop listening.
Plumber was late, broke a tile, and charged extra to replace it.
The room view was breathtaking and the bed might be the most comfortable I've slept in.
Subscription auto-renewed twice after I cancelled. Three months to fully unwind.
Movie had decent moments. Story didn't quite land. We finished it.
Therapist asked good questions in the first session. We'll see how the next one goes.
Game runs at 4K 60 without drops. Best port I've played in years.
Show was sold out. We got tickets to the next night without much hassle.
Their CLI silently corrupted my config file. Hours of work to rebuild.
Shoes fit true to size. Arch support was minimal.
My eight-year-old laughed all the way through. Already booked the sequel.
Got what I ordered. Packaging was generic. Delivery was on the late side of the window.
Trail was marked but signs faded in places. We didn't get lost.
Three different agents gave three different answers. Nobody owned the case.
Dress arrived with a tear on the seam. Customer service ignored two emails.
Pizza arrived hot, dough was perfect, and the toppings were generous.
Battery indicator lies. Says 30% then shuts off without warning.
Salad was generous. Dressing was on the salty side. I'd order it again.
Pool was closed all three days we were there. Resort didn't mention it at check-in.
The novel had three protagonists. Two were memorable.
My order was missing two items. Replacement shipping was billed to me.
Hotel was clean, breakfast was standard, location was central enough.
Tickets were oversold. They offered a $20 credit for being denied entry.
Concierge anticipated needs I hadn't even thought of yet. Five stars.
Steak was overcooked and the sides were salty enough to be inedible. Skip this place.
Coverage where my old carrier had zero bars. Switched and never looked back.
Trainer pushed exercises that aggravated an injury I had clearly mentioned.
Streaming quality at 1080p on a budget plan looks like 4K elsewhere.
My deposit was withheld for damages I documented before move-in.
My account was suspended without warning and support takes 48 hours to even read tickets.
App crashes whenever I try to upload a file over 5MB. Useless for my workflow.
Soundbar pairs flawlessly and the dialogue clarity setting actually works.
Cleanup-after-cooking is basically nil thanks to the new pan. Game changer.
Dental visit started 45 minutes late and the hygienist seemed rushed.
Charger cable frayed at the connector after a month of normal use.
Book had a strong start and a flat middle. Ending was acceptable.
Cleaner left the apartment in better shape than I'd ever managed myself.
Subscription auto-renewed on the right date. Charge was correct.
Photo prints came back saturated but not garish — exactly what I wanted.
Hotel breakfast had eggs, bread, and fruit. Coffee was acceptable.
Onboarding flow was the clearest I've seen — three steps and I was running.
They lost my luggage on a one-leg domestic flight. Three days to return it.
Restaurant brought the wrong dish twice. Server got defensive when we pointed it out.
Their support chatbot routed me in a loop for 40 minutes. Never reached a human.
Headphones disconnect every time I move my head. Useless on a walk.
Recliner went all the way back. Lever takes some force to engage.
Live class was small enough to get personal feedback. Best teacher I've had.
Salon stylist actually listened to what I wanted. Color came out exactly right.
Battery lasted the day. Phone charges in the time the manual says it would.
Couch arrived with a different fabric than the showroom sample. They wouldn't take it back.
